steps.name: Install Chromium before unit and end-to-end browser tests

decodedLogEvidence.method: Actual decoded GitHub job log fetched through the authorized GitHub connector after API-confirmed completion; saved as UTF-8 with LF newlines. Counts derived independently from the real summary in each named step. No guessed, reconstructed or storage-redirect-bypassed log.

cloudflareCheckoutProof.method: Actual Cloudflare build log HEAD marker, matching deployment full commit metadata and canonical production state. WWW is the existing redirect project, not an Astro build.

batchHttpsVerification.method: Actual HTTPS GET through inherited proxy and CA trust using standard Node fetch/TLS. No proxy bypass, browser fixtures, third-party provider requests, API writes, paid services, indexation requests or retries after source failures.

records.explanation: The unchanged homepage lists six latest stories; all batch guides are verified in the complete HTML guide index and whole-site reachability audit.

limitations: Expected/local source commit is a guard, not Cloudflare deployment identity evidence. Root verifies both actual project deployments separately.
Googlebot UA checks use this executor network address, not an authenticated Googlebot IP; they do not prove a Google crawl, indexing or ranking.
Search HTTP checks verify serialized published IDs and crawlable links; root independently tests live React behavior and mobile/desktop navigation.
All reviewed optimized new public photo files are compared against exact reviewed SHA256. Original archival source files remain local and are not claimed as publicly served.
No source, publication metadata, article approvals, tests, configs, advertisements, credentials or Cloudflare settings are mutated by this helper.

method.firstParty: Real HTTPS GET with inherited proxy and CA verification, unmodified response bodies/CSP replayed into Chromium; same resource cached within this QA only.
method.externalProviders: Isolated in the browser only to prevent ad impressions and Analytics; these are functional checks and are not speed metrics.
method.consent: Denied via browser initialization, never granted.
method.search: Actual Home GET form and linked Search result cards; Home has no autocomplete implementation. React filtering was exercised by changing the query and changing it back.

rootVisualReview.method: Actually viewed all three generated contact sheets with view_image, containing all fourteen original screenshots. Desktop thumbnails scaled to fit; this is a layout review, not a claim of full-resolution text inspection.
observations: Both Spanish and English new guide headers, title wrapping and cover images are legible at mobile390 and desktop1440; no clipping or overlap with the brand/menu was observed.
Dark blue header, orange/turquoise3Dbrand and existing advertisement containers are preserved.
Both mobile navigation dropdowns remain below the header/brand; search result cards and controls fit their viewports.
limitations: External ad/Analytics requests isolated in QA; empty advertising boxes do not verify or refute ad creative delivery.
Screenshots show viewport layout; all guide prose and individual photos are verified separately by source review, browser scroll checks and HTTPS checks.
No Google indexing, ranking, impression recovery or PageSpeed score verified.

scopeNotes: This receipt records only Braga and Fez, following the latest limit of two originals per execution. The historical three-topic reservation remains intact; George Town and all ten prepared New Year topics stay private and are not selected or counted in this release.
The source commit above is the actual CI/Cloudflare application commit. Any later evidence-only bookkeeping commit is separate and does not imply a new app deployment.

No SEO-code correction, Google indexing recovery, autonomous scheduler execution, ad creative delivery or PageSpeed score is claimed. Functional browser QA isolates external providers; advertising integration and source are preserved.
